A St. Louis lawyer's (Leon Ames) family (Judy Garland, Margaret O'Brien) stays in town for the 1904 World's Fair.
programme.title: Meet Me in St. Louis

programme.desc: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.
programme.title: National Velvet

programme.desc: Two brothers (Spencer Tracy, Robert Wagner) climb to a plane crash in the Alps: one to help, the other to loot.
programme.title: The Mountain

programme.desc: In order to help bring Nazis to justice, a U.S. agent brings a traitor's daughter to Rio de Janeiro to seduce an exiled Nazi.
programme.title: Notorious

programme.desc: Controversial British officer T.E. Lawrence (Peter O'Toole) learns the culture of Arabs (Alec Guinness, Anthony Quinn) and unites their tribes against the Turks.
programme.title: Lawrence of Arabia

programme.desc: A student hooker (Annie Potts) in a van picks up a Las Vegas-bound teen (Mark Hamill) on the trail of a stolen Stingray.
programme.title: Corvette Summer

programme.desc: The sled dog Buck helps a roughneck (Charlton Heston) and his partner to cover a lot of territory in Alaska.
programme.title: Call of the Wild

programme.desc: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.
programme.title: McLintock!

programme.desc: A hospital orderly creates havoc by igniting a patient's beard and stealing an ambulance to pursue his girlfriend.
programme.title: The Disorderly Orderly

programme.desc: A group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett.
programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.
programme.title: Belle Starr

programme.desc: Engaged to others, two cruise-ship passengers (Cary Grant, Deborah Kerr) plan to reunite six months later atop the Empire State Building.
programme.title: An Affair to Remember

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Lucy Gets Trapped Lucy feigns illness to have the day off to attend a department store sale.
programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Husbands Once Removed Without a marriage certificate to prove they're married, Blondie takes advantage of the situation to make Dagwood court her a second time.
programme.title: Blondie

programme.desc: A Broadway producer (Zero Mostel) and his accountant (Gene Wilder) back a sure-fire flop: "Springtime for Hitler."
programme.title: The Producers

programme.desc: During the Civil War, reports of a sea monster attacking ships alarm the Navy. An investigation finds the monster is a submarine, the "Nautilus," commanded by vengeance-seeking Capt. Nemo (Allen Holubar), who was once an Indian prince.
programme.title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea

programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
programme.title: Sitting Bull

programme.desc: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.
programme.title: His Girl Friday

programme.desc: A spy and the FBI hunt a petty thief (Richard Widmark) who has lifted microfilm from a woman's (Jean Peters) purse.
programme.title: Pickup on South Street

programme.desc: An unpopular captain (Gregory Peck) leads his cavalry troops to a mountain pass, to hold it against Apaches.
programme.title: Only the Valiant

programme.desc: Willie (Anne Baxter), a German woman, joins an American carnival passing through Munich. While traveling town to town, she joins Frank in his high-dive act, but tragedy is only a slip away.
programme.title: Carnival Story

programme.desc: A shady financier (Orson Welles) pays a man (Robert Arden) to research his past, in order to erase it with murder.
programme.title: Mr. Arkadin

programme.desc: S01 E26 — The Avenger A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.
programme.title: Bonanza

programme.desc: Superspy Derek Flint (James Coburn), agent of Z.O.W.I.E., stops a geothermal plot to control the world's weather.
programme.title: Our Man Flint

programme.desc: A modern-day blacksmith becomes the toast of King Arthur's court after being transported to sixth-century England.
programme.title: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court

programme.desc: A pet deer changes a boy (Claude Jarman Jr.) and his parents (Gregory Peck, Jane Wyman), pioneering farmers in Florida after the Civil War.
programme.title: The Yearling

programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.
programme.title: Raiders of Old California

programme.desc: One-eyed Marshal "Rooster" Cogburn (John Wayne) and a Texas Ranger (Glen Campbell) help a girl (Kim Darby) find her father's killer.
programme.title: True Grit

programme.desc: Ax murders follow a heart attack at an Irish castle full of mourners (William Campbell, Luana Anders, Bart Patton).
programme.title: Dementia 13

programme.desc: Two high-living adventurers settle in the world of fast cars, beautiful women and ruthless criminals.
programme.title: Mission: Monte Carlo

programme.desc: Seven children undertake the hazardous 2000-mile journey from Missouri to Oregon in the 1840s after their parents' death.
programme.title: Seven Alone

programme.desc: An Indian (Burt Reynolds) resorts to killing to stop an outlaw (Aldo Sambrell) and his gang from killing.
programme.title: Navajo Joe

programme.desc: Friends, relatives and a lawyer (Moses Gunn) question the case of a ghetto basketball star slain by a white policeman.
programme.title: Cornbread, Earl and Me

programme.desc: A hard-drinking dockworker (Jean Gabin), who may have killed a man, tries to make a new life with a waitress (Ida Lupino) he saved from a suicide attempt.
programme.title: Moontide

programme.desc: A woman (Patricia Neal) meets a man (Helmut Dantine) with no pulse who is here from Venus to warn Earth about the atom.
programme.title: The Stranger From Venus

programme.desc: Stan and Ollie rescue Bo-Peep, Tom-Tom and other Mother Goose characters from Toyland miser Barnaby.
programme.title: March of the Wooden Soldiers

programme.desc: Batman (Adam West) and Robin (Burt Ward) save Gotham City from the Catwoman, Joker (Cesar Romero), Penguin and Riddler.
programme.title: Batman

programme.desc: The arrival of wealthy bachelors in town causes an uproar when families with single daughters aggressively seek engagements, including the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters.
programme.title: Pride and Prejudice

programme.title: War of the Wildcats

programme.desc: While on a business trip, an ambitious, young lawyer immediately falls in love with a stranger. They wed the following day, and tragedy soon strikes.
